headline: Tensions flare as $34-billion Charter-Cox cable deal nears finish line
summary: Spectrum owner Charter Communications is nearing the finish line in its long-awaited $34.5-billion purchase of Cox Enterprises to form the nation's largest internet and cable television company. But consumer groups are seeking more protections for diversity and other measures.
